Ahu Whenua (Trust)(Search Scope: Ahu Whenua (Trust))


Trust. A land management trust involving whole block(s) of land.
Designed to promote the use and administration of the land in the interests of the owners.
Replaced sect. 438 Trusts under Māori Affairs Act 1953
(refer: Te Ture Whenua Māori Act 1993 sect. 215)
